using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
typedef long double ld;
typedef vector<int> vi;
typedef pair<int, int> ii;

#define FOR(var, from, to) for (int var = (int)(from); var < (int)(to); ++var)
#define FOR0(var, to)	for (int var = 0; var < (int)(to); ++var)

int x, y, n;

int nod(int a, int b) 
{
	if (a == 0)
		return b;
	else if (b == 0)
		return a;
	return nod(b, a % b);
}

int main()
{	
#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
#define cin fin
	ifstream fin("omg.txt");
#endif	
	cin >> x >> y >> n;
	ll a, b;

	if (n >= y) {
		int m = nod(x, y);
		a = x / m; b = y / m;
	} else {
		ld m = numeric_limits<ld>::max();
		FOR(i, 1, n+1) {
			ld aa =	floorl((ld)x * i / y);
			if (abs(aa/i - (ld)x / y) < m) {
				a = aa; b = i;
				m = abs(aa/i - (ld)x / y);
			}

			aa = ceill((ld)x * i / y);
			if (abs(aa/i - (ld)x / y) < m) {
				a = aa; b = i;
				m = abs(aa/i - (ld)x / y);
			}
		}		
	}

	cout << a << "/" << b << endl;

	return 0;
}
